performance_claim_scope: exact Poolside Laguna S 2.1 Q4_K_M pp512 shared/routed MoE overlap on gfx1151 with GPU_MAX_HW_QUEUES=2, plus clean 512/1K/4K candidate measurements

candidate.schedule: the shared expert runs on a nonblocking secondary stream while router selection and routed gate/up/down run on the caller stream
candidate.dependencies: one timing-disabled input-ready event and one timing-disabled shared-output-ready event
candidate.fallback: the established sequential single-stream branch remains unchanged

clean_candidate.command: HIP_VISIBLE_DEVICES=0 HIPENGINE_HIP_ARCH=gfx1151 GPU_MAX_HW_QUEUES=2 HIPENGINE_COMPILER_VERSION_FILE=/tmp/laguna_hipcc_version.txt HIPENGINE_REQUIRE_CACHED_BUILD=1 PYTHONPATH=. .venv/bin/python3 -u scripts/laguna_long_context_profile.py --lengths 512,1024,4096 --chunk-size 2048 --repetitions 3 --warmup-rows 128 --compiler-version-file /tmp/laguna_hipcc_version.txt --require-cached-build --moe-branch-concurrency --output <tmp>

rocprof.command: HIP_VISIBLE_DEVICES=0 HIPENGINE_HIP_ARCH=gfx1151 GPU_MAX_HW_QUEUES=2 HIPENGINE_COMPILER_VERSION_FILE=/tmp/laguna_hipcc_version.txt HIPENGINE_REQUIRE_CACHED_BUILD=1 PYTHONPATH=. rocprofv3 --kernel-trace --output-format csv --output-directory <tmp> --output-file moe-concurrent -- .venv/bin/python3 -u scripts/laguna_long_context_profile.py --lengths 512,1024,4096 --chunk-size 2048 --repetitions 1 --warmup-rows 128 --compiler-version-file /tmp/laguna_hipcc_version.txt --require-cached-build --moe-branch-concurrency --output <tmp>/child.json
rocprof.contention_note: overlapped family durations are not additive critical-path time; concurrent dense/shared and router classifications grow while wall span falls

decision.reason: the exact queue-matched A/B wins 7/7 and the trace proves real overlap, but production promotion still requires architecture capability and process queue-policy integration
